title: USB Audio: Dissect MIDIStreaming MIDI Element descriptor.
description:
Follows section 6.1.2.4 of the USB Device Class Definition for MIDI Devices,
Release 1.0.

Sample capture: [usb-descriptor-midi-element-not-implemented-2bytecaps.pcapng](/uploads/4127f84248b8991cf2bcccb5f57482d4/usb-descriptor-midi-element-not-implemented-2bytecaps.pcapng)

(Note that the sample capture is generated using a custom-developed TinyUSB MIDI device... in other words, I had to construct the MIDI Element descriptor which is being dissected, so I can't absolutely guarantee its correctness.  I don't have any manufactured USB MIDI devices which natively have a MIDI Element descriptor.)
